title: Construction of a translational whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic model to investigate the biodistribution of lipid nanoparticle-based mRNA therapeutics for intracellular protein targets.
caption: Schematic of the whole-body PBPK model ( A ) and sub-compartments in liver tissue ( B ). Blood flows are indicated by black solid arrows, lymphatic flows are depicted by dashed black arrows, and other cellular processes were presented by green solid arrows. SI: small intestine. LI: large intestine
